__comment: Pemmican recipe compat (gated on pemmican): let Wildcraft dried fruit be the optional berry/fruit in pemmican, mirroring Pemmican's own EF dried-fruit slot. Accepts our oven/rack-dried fruit (driedfruit-*) and Wildcraft's naturally-dry fruit (dryfruit-* — juniper, sumac, hackberry...). Uses a distinct ingredient code (wildfruit-base) so it coexists with the EF fruit slot rather than colliding. minQuantity 0 keeps it optional; the shared shapeElement + textureMapping melds it into the pemmican blob (no separate mesh).
